scope: First physical iOS focused local QA; current native runtime, synthetic isolated test state.
installation: Succeeded after developer-image setup; initial locked-device mount and launch failures retained.
tested: Device-hosted authenticated encryption, tamper/wrong-key rejection, CRUD/edit/delete/reopen and failed-open preservation.
Exact original receipt bytes across save/export/restore/delete; Vision OCR on a generated synthetic receipt image.
Physical file protection class and descriptor readback; isolated device-only recovery-key alias attributes.
Coordinated v4 destination readback, existing-file preservation, guarded candidate installation and fresh-store reopen.
Actual UI add/edit/delete with process terminate/relaunch; UI state is the QA app temporary PennyUITests directory.
limits: Only ca.penny.offline.dev and its test runner were installed. Shipping identifiers were never install/reset/launch targets.
Network and account settings were unchanged; this run does not establish airplane-mode behavior or absence of network traffic.
The Keychain test uses its own recovery-key alias; default-key hardware guarantees and locked-device denial remain unproven.
Vision uses a generated image, not the physical camera. Camera/HEIC quality, cloud providers, device-to-device migration, accessibility/resources and release signing remain open.
Generative model availability is qualified separately. This run has no inference-quality evidence.

The 324 source/binary pins were verified before later test-only rebuilds replaced DerivedData products. Original binary hashes and test evidence remain; original bundle bytes were not separately frozen. The later offline report pins separately preserved final products.
